verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 95.7 (-2.3% in a day) and momentum is 42: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,400 and 86s 4,800. Rivals rewards just paid out, so fodder supply is high this morning.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 5,500 coins. Now 4,800. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 5,500 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 3 so far, averaging +19.1% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Sell Tasos Douvikas 86 Star Performer after its 25% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 100,000 coins. Now 68,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 24.8% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 7 of 13 so far, averaging +5.3% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Rivals rewards just paid out: buy SBC fodder now, not later
moves.detail: Rewards add fodder to the market on Thursday morning, which usually makes it cheapest then. Buy what your SBCs need now; selling it again costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,400 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,800 (1.17 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,500 (1.18 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,500 (1.39 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Romelu Lukaku and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Romelu Lukaku 87 UEFA Champions League RTTK -64.3%; Barbara Bonansea 82 Rare -60.0%; Jorge Cuenca 76 Rare -50.9%; Tasos Douvikas 86 Star Performer -48.9%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Olivia Smith SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 17.9K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
